_comment: Line-count ratchet for the files that concentrate churn. Fails ONLY IF a tracked file GROWS past its baseline; it never fails just for being big today. This is T01 of docs/reports/contract-ui-churn-analysis.md (the 'max-lines that fails CI if they grow' guardrail) implemented as a ratchet instead of a fixed ESLint threshold, which would either block every PR today or sit so high it permits the growth it should stop. Pay debt down by extracting sub-components (§9.2, target: no file over ~600 lines), then run `npx sf-file-lines-budget --update` to lock in the lower number (`make file-lines-budget` checks, `--list` enumerates). `baseline` counts physical lines, comments and blanks included — the metric only has to be consistent and monotonic.

files.label: DetailView.jsx
files.note: God component of the generic contract-ui. Report §9.1 measured ~3.914 lines; it has since grown by ~1.242 with no guard in place — exactly the gap this ratchet closes.
